name: Ipca Laboratories Ltd
about: Ipca Laboratories is an integrated pharmaceutical company manufacturing branded and generic formulations, APIs and intermediates. Indian branded formulations are its core profit engine, complemented by formulation exports across Europe, Africa, the Americas, Asia, CIS and Australasia. The consolidated business includes Unichem Laboratories and its US, Brazil, Europe and South Africa operations.[1]
keyPoints: Integrated nature of operations Ipca Laboratories is a fully integrated pharmaceutical company that manufactures over 350 formulations and 80 APIs for various therapeutic segments. [1] IPCA is among India’s top 20 pharmaceutical companies. [2] Business segments FY26: API Business[3] Ipca produces over 80 APIs; nearly 79% of the APIs and Intermediates business is from exports, making them one of India’s top exporters of APIs, serving over 100 countries around the globe.
cons: Stock is trading at 5.32 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 12.9% over last 3 years.

announcements.text: CLOSING OF MANUFACTURING OPERATION AND SALE OF LEASEHOLD LAND AND OLD FACTORY BUILDINGS / STRUCTURES / SHEDS STANDING THEREON AT COMPANY'S DRUG INTERMEDIATES / BULK DURGS MANUFACTURING UNIT SITUATED AT MIDC MAHAD 20 Nov - Ipca to close Mahad drug intermediates unit; sell leasehold land/buildings to ICMC Corp for ₹16.90 crore.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome 6 Nov - Ipca Labs held Q2 FY27 earnings call; consolidated revenue rose 14% to INR2,910 crore, EBITDA margin 22.97%.
